Update anautomat directly on your Android device.

- Check this repository’s stable GitHub Releases automatically about every six hours, with optional notifications, or check manually in the Updates card.
- Download and verify an APK in the app, then open Android’s installation confirmation. The first use requires allowing installs from anautomat in Android Settings.
- Verify SHA-256, release asset identity, package ID, version and the installed signing certificate before handing the APK to Android. Active or paused Goals must be ended before installation.
- Disable background update checks in the app whenever you want. No PC, update server, extra SDK or account is needed.

Install this release once using the APK below to enable future in-app updates. Install it over your existing production release to keep sign-in and settings. Android battery restrictions may delay background checks. Development builds use a different signing key and cannot update to production APKs in place.
